chunks.text: Hobbies are activities we do in our free time because we enjoy them.
Whether it's reading, playing sports or painting, hobbies help us relax and have fun.
Part one, common words related to hobbies.
First, let's learn some important words that are related to hobbies.
I will say each word slowly and you can repeat after me.
Hobby, an activity you do for fun in your free time.
Free time, time when you don't have work or other responsibilities.
Relax, to rest and feel calm.
Interest, something that you enjoy or care about.
Activity, an action or thing that you do.
Sports, physical activities like football, tennis or basketball.
Creative, making something new like drawing or writing.
Collection, a group of things that you keep for fun like stamps or coins.
Part two, useful phrases about hobbies.
Now let's practice some useful phrases you can use when talking about your hobbies.
I will say each phrase twice.
Listen carefully and repeat after me.
What is your hobby?
My hobby is, I like to, I enjoy, I spend time, I'm interested in, how often do you do your hobby?
I do it every day, weekend.
I started doing it when I was a child.
I think it's fun because I've been doing it for part three, common hobbies.
Now let's talk about some common hobbies that people enjoy.
I will describe them and you can learn the words and phrases for each one.
Reading, reading is a great way to relax and learn new things.
I love reading books.
My favorite type of book is fiction.
I read for 30 minutes every day.
Sports.
Sports are a fun way to stay active.
I play football every weekend.
I like swimming in the summer.
My favorite sport is tennis.
Cooking.
Cooking is a creative and enjoyable hobby.
I enjoy cooking dinner for my family.
I like to try new recipes.
My favorite dish to cook is pasta.
Traveling.
Traveling allows you to visit new places and experience different cultures.
I love traveling to new countries.
I usually travel with my friends or family.
I want to visit Japan next year.
Drawing or painting.
Drawing or painting is a great way to express yourself.
I like drawing landscapes.
Painting helps me relax.
I've been painting for five years.
Part four, talking about how often you do your hobby.
When talking about hobbies, it's important to know how to say how often you do them.
Here are some useful phrases.
I do it every day.
I do it once a week.
I do it once a month.
I do it on the weekend.
I do it in my free time.
I do it when I feel like it.
Part five, common questions about hobbies.
Here are some common questions you might ask someone about their hobbies.
These will help you in conversations.
What do you do in your free time?
How long have you been doing this hobby?
Why do you enjoy it?
When did you start doing it?
Who do you do it with?
Do you do it alone or with others?
What's your favorite hobby?
Part six, common problems or challenges with hobbies.
Sometimes there are challenges with hobbies.
Let's look at some ways to talk about them.
I don't have enough time for my hobby.
I'm too tired to do my hobby.
It's hard to find a place to practice my hobby.
I don't have all the equipment I need.
